title: The keeper's last night
hook: For forty years, one man kept the light burning.

characters.name: Elias
characters.look: a lighthouse keeper with a grey beard and a wool coat

beats.say: For forty years, Elias kept the light burning on the rocks.
beats.see: A lighthouse on a rocky coast at night, storm clouds rolling in from the sea

beats.say: Tonight would be his last watch.
beats.see: Elias lights an old oil lantern in the keeper's cottage

beats.say: Every step up the tower was a year of his life.
beats.see: Elias climbs the spiral stairs, the lantern swinging in his hand
Lightning splits the sky over the sea; waves crash on the rocks below

beats.say: Then he saw them: lights, far too close to the rocks.
beats.see: Through the rain, a ship in trouble rolls on the waves, its lights flickering

beats.say: He sounded the horn until his arms gave out.
beats.see: Elias pulls the foghorn cord again and again

beats.say: And the old lamp turned, one last time, for them.
beats.see: The camera circles slowly round the great lamp as it turns

beats.say: By dawn the ship was safe. The light was his to put out.
beats.see: Dawn over a calm sea, the ship safe in the harbour; Elias sits by the cold lamp
